mapper.select: SELECT permission_id, permission_code, permission_name, permission_group FROM permission WHERE permission_id IN ( SELECT permission_id FROM hr_role_permission WHERE hr_role_id = #{hrRoleId} ) ORDER BY permission_id

SELECT permission_id, permission_code, permission_name, permission_group FROM permission
AND ( permission_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR permission_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND permission_group = #{permissionGroup}
ORDER BY permission_id
SELECT permission_id, permission_code, permission_name, permission_group FROM permission WHERE permission_id = #{permissionId}
SELECT permission_id, permission_code, permission_name, permission_group FROM permission WHERE permission_code = #{permissionCode}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_role_permission WHERE permission_id = #{permissionId}
